_note: FICTIONAL TEACHING DATA. Every service code, diagnosis code, pair and modifier below was invented for ClaimGuard AI and has no clinical or commercial meaning. The rule logic follows real claim-validation practice (see docs/30_Extension_Rules.md); these attributes do not come from any real code table. None of them is in the official teaching catalogue (rules/services.json, rules/diagnoses.json).

SVC-EXT-RX.description: Fictional pharmaceutical item that must state its route

DX-EXT-SECONDARY.display: Fictional diagnosis reserved for secondary position

rules.name: Procedure pair without exception modifier
rules.corrective_action: Bill the pair as one comprehensive service, or attach an exception modifier and supporting documentation if the two services were truly distinct.

rules.name: Exception modifier on a never-bundle pair
rules.corrective_action: Remove the exception modifier: this pair may not be separated by a modifier. Bill the comprehensive service.

rules.name: Event date required by the diagnosis
rules.corrective_action: Add the event date to the notes or an attachment as 'Event date: YYYY-MM-DD', on or before the first service date.

rules.name: Route of administration missing
rules.corrective_action: Attach the route-of-administration modifier to the pharmaceutical line.

rules.name: Diagnosis cannot be primary
rules.corrective_action: Place the underlying condition first and move this diagnosis to a secondary position.

rules.name: Line duplicates an earlier claim
rules.corrective_action: Confirm whether this service was already billed on an earlier claim; withdraw the duplicate line.

rules.name: Authorization exhausted across claims
rules.corrective_action: Request an extension of the authorization or reduce the billed quantity to what remains.

rules.name: Daily quantity exceeded across claims
rules.corrective_action: Check earlier claims for the same service, patient, provider and date; remove units already billed.
